pr.title: refactor(client-runtime): decide learned routes and session reuse in one place
pr.body: ## What changed - **Learned routes and plain HTTP.** `mergeLearnedRoutes` in `packages/client-runtime/src/connection/routes.ts` only learns a plain-HTTP address outside the tailnet when the paired credential it borrows was itself paired over plain HTTP to a LAN or public address. Relay credentials are unchanged. - **SSH session reuse.** The SSH route's bearer token is saved in the connection catalog (`SshConnectionRegistration` carries it, `storageDocument` stores it, and removing the route drops it). The resolver's SSH broker passes the saved token to `SshEnvironmentGateway.prepare` and saves the token that comes back. The desktop gateway (`prepareDesktopSshEnvironment` in `apps/web/src/connection/platform.ts`) brings up the tunnel, checks the host's environment id, then checks the saved session through the existing `fetchSshSessionState` IPC. It reuses the session if it is valid and holds every standard client scope. Otherwise it pairs again through the add-environment path. - **Docs.** `docs/user/remote-access.md` describes one session per desktop per SSH route and how to revoke unused ones, including the CLI. `docs/internals/remote.md` notes the plain-HTTP rule for learned routes. The server and `packages/ssh` are unchanged. ## Behavior changes - A token paired over HTTPS, loopback, or the tailnet no longer gets copied to a learned plain-HTTP LAN or public address. Tailnet plain-HTTP addresses are still learned. - SSH reconnects and app restarts reuse one host session per desktop instead of creating a new 30-day session on every connect. Adding an environment and its first connect share that session. - If the saved session is revoked, expired, or missing a standard scope, the next connect pairs once and saves the new token. Errors from the session check (network, 5xx) fail the attempt so the supervisor retries. They never pair. - If a saved SSH route now reaches a different environment, the connect fails before pairing or sending the saved token. - Older catalogs have no saved SSH token, so each desktop pairs once on its first connect after updating. ## Testing - `tsc-rs --noEmit` in `packages/client-runtime` and `apps/web`: both pass. - `vp test run src/connection` in `packages/client-runtime`: 9 files, 176 tests passed. - `vp test run --project unit src/connection/platform.test.ts` in `apps/web`: 18 tests passed. - The full suite was not run locally. CI covers it. 🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code) Closes #20288 ---

@@ -179,6 +179,12 @@ If SSH reconnecting fails after an app update, retry the launch once. Removing
 the connection stops a server that T3 Code launched; a server that was already
 running is left alone.
 
+Each desktop app keeps one session on the host for its SSH connection and reuses
+it when it reconnects. Revoke sessions you no longer use in **Settings →
+Connections** on the host, or on a headless host with `t3 auth session list` and

+again on its next connect.
